value.rationale: An entire infinite family of standard moment-curve cyclic polytopes has a complete parametric metric classification with at most three ball contacts, including a sharp even-dimensional scale transition and stability under arbitrary addition of interior-parameter vertices. This distinguishes canonical Euclidean geometry from combinatorial and Ehrhart equivalence and has a reusable nonstandard positivity/barycentric certificate. The finding is not just a numerical enumeration or isolated example.
